mechanism.plausibility_rationale: Adenosine is an endogenous nucleoside with an extremely short half-life (less than 10 seconds) due to rapid uptake and metabolism by erythrocytes and vascular endothelial cells. Because it is rapidly cleared and does not undergo significant hepatic metabolism or accumulation, it is not associated with drug-induced liver injury or hepatotoxicity in clinical practice.
